summary: Saturday is the week — a prime ESE long-period swell fills Rockaway to overhead-ish 4.5ft at 12.5s with afternoon glass-off, and it's your home break, so no drive required. The rest of the stretch is small summer SE junk best surfed glassy at dawn, with Sunday bringing bigger short-period S to Ditch and Matunuck if you want a fair-angle roll of the dice, and Monday getting broadly blown out by W wind. Build the weekend around Saturday afternoon at Rockaway and save the gas money.
